comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks an assembled gripper’s opening stop; PR-2251 installs and electrically engages a T8 tube in two rotor lampholders.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests concentric two-tool screw/nut counterholding and later lever actuation; PR-2251 tests bimanual support of a long fragile tube, simultaneous dual-end pin insertion, and coordinated quarter-turn rotation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a retained 90° opening across three cycles with limited drift, retained nuts, and withdrawn tools; PR-2251 requires both pin pairs inserted, both rotors at their 90° stops, illumination, release, and one-second stillness.
comparison.reason: Although both involve angular regulation and functional verification, dual-end lamp insertion and rotation do not exercise coupled screw-and-locknut adjustment under countertorque; no material comparison rubric detail is missing.
